pages.text: $(bold)Sky Manipulation$(): ride the open sky, part the clouds to see the sun. $(br2)$(bold)Forward activation$(): with a hostile target in your line of sight, $(bold)knock it flying along the sight direction$() (pure displacement, dealing no damage); with no target, you instead give yourself a push along the sight direction (dash / leap through the air; the upward-tossed part causes no fall damage). $(br2)Push scales with $(bold)Cursed Energy Affinity / Output$(): strength = (1+Affinity/100)×(1.6+Output×0.15), cost = (1+Affinity/100)×(6+Output×3).

$(bold)Reversal · Ushura-dan$(): press the reversal key (F) to fire an $(bold)Ushura-dan$() at the target locked by your sight — it tracks its target lightly; on impact it bursts into snow-crystal fragments $(bold)like shattering thin ice$(), knocking space itself along with the opponent $(bold)flying$() (massive knockback + upward toss) and dealing $(bold)cursed technique damage$() (shared damage base ×110%, applying wand boosts; core material traits apply on hit). $(br2)Knockback and cost scale with Affinity/Output: cost = (1+Affinity/100)×(12+Output×5). $(br2)It cannot be fired without a locked target (prompt: no target).
